annotation.authors_or_issuer: Kementerian Komunikasi dan Informatika Republik Indonesia (Menteri Komunikasi dan Informatika)
key_provisions_or_claims: Addressed to AI programming business actors and public and private electronic system operators.
Provides ethical guidance values and controls for AI consulting, analysis and programming activities.
Grounded in the ITE Law, Personal Data Protection Law, GR 71/2019 and MCI Regulation 3/2021.
Aims to mitigate social, economic and defence-related harms from AI use.
Non-binding circular letter (surat edaran) rather than a regulation.
annotation.summary_en: Indonesian Minister of Communication and Informatics Circular Letter No. 9 of 2023 on AI Ethics. It gives non-binding ethical guidance to AI programming businesses and public and private electronic system operators, covering values, ethics and controls for AI development and use. It is general AI guidance with no robotics-specific provisions.
annotation.title_clean: Surat Edaran Menteri Komunikasi dan Informatika Nomor 9 Tahun 2023 tentang Etika Kecerdasan Artifisial
annotation.title_en: Circular Letter of the Minister of Communication and Informatics No. 9 of 2023 on Artificial Intelligence Ethics
